claims.claim: Published permanence and competitive Poincare–Bendixson properties
dependencies: Smith 2012, Theorems 1.3 and 1.4; model-specific Poincare–Bendixson statement
claims.boundary: Positive rates and the original, not mass-conserving, oscillator.

claims.claim: Exact projective Floquet mean and factorisation
claims.boundary: Applies to arbitrary positive mu; equality of the mean is neutral and does not decide nonlinear stability.

dependencies: periodic extrema of positive ratio equations
claims.boundary: Requires a positive state range for the considered cycle; no period upper bound is assumed.

claims.claim: Strict supporting-plane comparison and equilibrium cones
claims.boundary: Base must be a cycle or equilibrium; the other trajectory is bounded in logarithmic coordinates for all time.

claims.claim: One crest and trough, nested planar projections and ordered crests
claims.boundary: Every possible nonconstant positive cycle, not only stable cycles.

claims.claim: Six nondegenerate chemical extrema in the original filter order
claims.boundary: X-min < Z-min < Y-min < X-max < Z-max < Y-max, cyclically; no swap of physical filters.

claims.claim: Positive crest derivative and determinant less than exp(-4*pi)
claims.boundary: A positive small-determinant return matrix need not have spectral radius below one.

claims.claim: Convex supporting epigraph, rank-one local Hessian and graph defect
claims.boundary: Finite selected family of actual cycles plus equilibrium; epigraph is invariant, graph generally is not. No algorithm to find cycles and no equivalence for unrelated planar trajectories.

claims.claim: Proper family of all crest-fixed cycles on finite parameter sets
claims.boundary: Compact sets strictly inside mu>0 and k>mu*(1+mu); no compactness at Hopf, zero rate or infinity.

claims.claim: Globally unique Hopf starting collar for every fixed rate ratio
dependencies: uniform attraction in a common physical positive box
claims.boundary: Existential collar; no numerical width is certified.

claims.claim: Relatively closed neutral locus and finite-path count obstruction
claims.boundary: Failure of uniqueness forces a nonconstant cycle with extra +1, possibly at the target endpoint. Neutrality is not itself a counterexample.

claims.claim: Equivalent trace test and necessary neutral-variance window
claims.boundary: Necessary constraints, not an exclusion of neutral cycles.

claims.claim: Square-root radial contraction vector is not a universal certificate
claims.boundary: Analytic failure for each 0<mu<1 sufficiently close to Hopf; not a counterexample to cycle attraction or uniqueness.

claims.claim: 50 exact equalities and complete 31-cycle finite audit reproduce
dependencies: bundled active code and saved meshes
claims.boundary: No formal proof assistant; no interval arithmetic; finite checks do not exclude other cycles.
No full solution, no no-neutral theorem and no certified multicycle counterexample.
